title: Integration merge resurrects RESULT-*.md: 06t's removal never landed
body:
keepReportsOut sets every worker report in a merge into the integration branch to what the epic head has, including when the incoming branch DELETES it. So 06t's commit 0b9b9087 (which removes the seven RESULT-{378,3gk,7uv,hn6,ltg,oro,r5i}.md) was merged as eb368bab with all seven restored, and they are still at the root of epic/hn6. The epic's PR would land them on main, the thing #172 cleaned up. No tick can remove them through the run's merge path. What would make it ready: let keepReportsOut honour a report deletion the incoming head makes against the merge base (a deletion can never land a new report or cause a report conflict), or commit the removal straight onto epic/hn6. Then add a test that merges a deleting attempt through mergeInWorktree and asserts the integrated head carries no RESULT-*.md. 06t's test exercised only the base-fold mint path.
evidence: git ls-tree --name-only 0b9b90872 | grep -c RESULT -> 0; git ls-tree --name-only eb368babe | grep -c RESULT -> 7 (same at HEAD 36a5e925); internal/reconcile/report_merge.go:24-30,44-75
